name: week
title: Enablement week
subtitle: Fictional demo until you import your own records

sections.title: Rep progress
sections.sql: select rep,program,tasks,achieved,overdue,unverified,due_on,status from ramp_status order by rep

sections.title: Coaching actions
sections.sql: select r.name rep,c.coach,c.topic,c.due_on from coaching c join reps r on r.id=c.rep_id where c.status='open' order by c.due_on

sections.title: Evidence still needed
sections.sql: select rep,program,milestone,verified_value,target,unit,due_on,overdue from milestone_status where not achieved order by due_on,rep

sections.title: Program results
sections.sql: select name,owner,enrolled,completed,overdue_milestones,unverified_milestones from program_summary order by name

sections.title: Playbook review dates
sections.sql: select name,owner,location,review_on from playbooks order by review_on
